title: Sanctioned Entity Data Transfer Prohibition

sections.text: No data of any kind may be shared with entities on the Sanctioned Entity List maintained by the Compliance department.
This prohibition applies to all datasets, all departments, all regions, and all vendor types without exception.
This prohibition may not be waived under any circumstances, including by the Data Governance Committee, the Chief Data Officer, or any other executive authority.
Any attempt to circumvent this prohibition must be reported to the Chief Compliance Officer immediately and constitutes grounds for disciplinary action.
Sanctioned Entity means any person, company, or organization listed on applicable government sanctions lists (OFAC SDN, EU Sanctions, UN Security Council) or the internal Compliance Watch List.

source: Compliance Policy Register — Mandatory Compliance Order MCO-2025-001
